name: aeo-docs-scorer
description: Score developer documentation for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO): llms.txt, agent skills, MCP, markdown mirrors, and more.
author: meharshit

scripts.build: npm run build -w @aeo-docs-scorer/rubric && npm run build -w @aeo-docs-scorer/scanner && npm run build -w @aeo-docs-scorer/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @aeo-docs-scorer/rubric && npm run test -w @aeo-docs-scorer/scanner && vitest run apps/web/rate-limit.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @aeo-docs-scorer/rubric && npm run typecheck -w @aeo-docs-scorer/scanner && npm run typecheck -w @aeo-docs-scorer/web
